From the manufacturer

EST. 1997, Santa Monica Sands

Since 1997, we’ve been addicted to the Golden State’s laidback, playful way of life. The cliff-lined beaches, the mountain trails, the breezy boardwalks. The year-round sunshine that inspires endless adventures and a unique, life’s-for-living attitude. And, of course, the casual-chic style that defines the Southern Californian look.

It's why we created Rocket Dog. We wanted to make women's shoes that radiated the SoCal spirit. Which meant fusing dawn-till-dusk comfort with fun, vibrant, and edgy design. Like the typical Californian girl, we take global trends and make them our own. This gives every style a refreshing individuality, whilst staying directly on the pulse.

While trends change with every season, our dedication to injecting the SoCal Spirit into every style remains the same.

Box Fresh Comfort

We want our shoes to offer you unbeatable all day comfort, so we’ve created an inlay that’s so incredibly soft, it feels as though you’re walking on clouds.

Our Plush Foam combines a generous 7mm of memory foam with 2mm of EVA to create an inlay like no other. It’s deep, it’s soft, and it’s luxuriously cushioned, offering exceptional comfort with every single step.

Playful Styling

We believe that life’s for living, so we inject playfulness into all the products we produce from our summer sandals and flip flips to our tall boots and slippers.

This youthful attitude is typical of Southern California. Which is why every style we create celebrates our playful attitude by fusing all-day comfort with fun, vibrant and distinctive designs.

Proudly Original

We're known for our imaginative prints, platform flip-flops, and rainbow wedges.

These original styles define our individuality, ensuring we're always on the pulse, but in an off-beat Rocket Dog kinda way.

How to find the right shoe size for you

Why is this important?

Every shoe manufacturer uses different lasts in terms of instep height, toe shape and foot width. However, the basis for finding your own shoe size is always the length of your feet. Thus, you should always determine your foot length before buying in order to choose the right shoe.

Step 1: tracing your feet

Take off your socks, place a piece of paper against a wall, and place your foot on it so that your heel touches the wall. Now use a pen to trace the shape of the foot on the front of the toes. Hold the pen exactly upright.

Important: Both feet must be measured, as they are often of different lengths! Feet often swell during the day, which is why we recommend taking the measurement in the late afternoon.

Step 2: measure and add

Now you can measure the edge of the paper from where the heel was to the longest toe and determine the length of your foot. Use your longer foot as a guidance. You get the required inner length of the shoe by adding an extra of 0.4 inch to your foot length.

Step 3: Look it up in the shoe size table

Our shoe size table helps you convert your own foot measurements into manufacturer sizes in order to make the right choice.

Product Description

The Cheery White Color Block Sneakers! Combining soft hues of lavender, mint, and beige with a crisp white platform sole, these sneakers offer a subtle lift to both your height and outfit. Each color block is carefully crafted for a harmonious blend, making them perfect for pairing with neutral tones or soft pastels. Tie them up with their pristine white laces over the soft cotton lining, and let the plush foam insole carry you in comfort. Whether it's a day out with friends or a casual workday, add a touch of sophistication to your walk.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Thinking about buying them for a trip where you're walking a lot? Don't.

    I went to Europe, and my feet were so sore each night. My feet did not feel supported, and they left my heels/bottom of foot very sore. The toe box pushed my pinky toe in slightly and didn't give it much space. It is the correct size and true to size. It was the narrow spacing of the toe box area that caused the issues. Thankfully, they did not cause any blisters.

    They are cute but began fraying on the heel the same day I started wearing them. I don't imagine they will last very long.

    3 stars because they aren't expensive. This is truly a case of "you get what you pay for".

    I would not recommend them for anything over 8,000 steps. Which is very clearly not intended for a trip where walking is key.
